nodes.source_text: The HER performance of NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH, Ir_{SAC}-NiFeLDH, NiFe-LDH, and NF was tested in a typical threeelectrode system in 1 M KOH solution. As illustrated in Figure 3A,B, NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH only required an overpotential of 28.5 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm^{-2}... NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH exhibited the lowest Tafel slope of 32.9 mV dec^{-1}... Chronopotentiometry tests showed that NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH displayed remarkable long-term durability of over 120 h at a current density of 200 mA cm^{-2}... NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH showed C_{dl} value of 5.71 mF cm^{-2}... the turnover frequency (TOF) value of NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH at η_{100} was 2.829 s^{-1}

The OER performance of the synthesized and commercial catalysts was evaluated in 1 M KOH as well. As shown in Figure 4A,B, Ir_{SAC}-NiFe-LDH exhibited an ultralow overpotential (194 mV) at 10 mA cm^{-2} with a small Tafel slope of 33.3 mV dec^{-1}... The C_{dl} value of Ir_{SAC}-NiFe-LDH (7.11 mF cm^{-2})... the TOF value of Ir_{SAC}-NiFe-LDH at an overpotential of 250 mV was 1.632 s^{-1}... Ir_{SAC}-NiFe-LDH also exhibited extraordinary OER stability without obvious decay at a high current of 200 mA cm^{-2} after 120 h of operation

nodes.description: Overall water splitting performance (NiIr_SAA_NiFe_LDH as cathode)
nodes.source_text: a two-electrode water electrolyzer was assembled with Ir_{SAC}-NiFe-LDH and NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH as the anode and cathode, respectively... the NiIr_{SAA}-NiFe-LDH||Ir_{SAC}-NiFe-LDH electrolyzer only needed a small cell voltage of 1.49 V at 10 mA cm^{-2} (without iR compensation)... The Faradaic efficiency (FE) for the HER and OER was close to 100%... the assembled electrolyzer remained stable over 120 h of continuous operation at 200 mA cm^{-2}

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir L3-edge XANES shows valence state order: IrSAC-NiFe-LDH > IrO2 > NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH > Ir foil.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As revealed by the Ir L3-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra in Figure 2A, the intensity of the white line edge suggested that the valence state of as-prepared catalysts decreased in the order IrSAC-NiFe-LDH > IrO2 > NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH > Ir foil.

nodes.characterization_summary: IrSAC-NiFe-LDH shows Ir-O coordination at 1.6 Å with coordination number 6; NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH shows Ir-Ni coordination at 2.3 Å with coordination number 5.78; no Ir-Ir coordination.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the R space spectra (Figure 2B), there was only a single peak located at 1.6 Å in IrSAC-NiFe-LDH... For NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH, a predominant peak appeared at 2.3 Å... the EXAFS fitting result of IrSAC-NiFe-LDH indicated that the Ir single atom was coordinated by six oxygen atoms... The EXAFS fitting result of NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH manifested that the coordination number of the Ni-Ir shell was 5.78.

nodes.characterization_summary: Only Ir-O in IrSAC-NiFe-LDH and Ir-Ni in NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH observed; Ir-Ir coordination invisible, confirming single dispersion of Ir.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Only Ir-O and Ir-Ni coordination can be observed in IrSAC-NiFe-LDH and IrSAA-NiFe-LDH, respectively. Ir-Ir coordination was invisible for both IrSAC-NiFe-LDH and IrSAA-NiFe-LDH, demonstrating a single dispersion of Ir.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir loadings: 8.47 wt% in IrSAC-NiFe-LDH and 8.31 wt% in NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The loadings of Ir in IrSAC-NiFe-LDH and NiIrSAA-NiFe-LDH were measured to be 8.47 and 8.31 wt %, respectively (Figures S1 and S2).
